claim_ceiling: Dense embeddings are COMPLEMENTARY, not PRIMARY. They excel at citation heritage recovery (AUC 0.77-0.85 > TF-IDF 0.71-0.74) and section cross-lingual alignment (Sachverhalt 0.282, Dispositiv 0.150), but FAIL jurist preference gate at ALL scales (JP 0.05-0.43). True OOS jurist preference ceiling ~0.53 < 0.7 factory target. Linear hybrids PASS adversarial gates at 19yr+ (JP 0.61-0.67) but remain below TF-IDF baseline (0.78-0.79). Product requires multi-view architecture: TF-IDF hybrids for primary navigation; dense for citation heritage and cross-lingual views. 174k dense delivery blocked on corpus lane (bge_/bger_ mapping, parquet 2024-2026, section extraction).
evidence_summary: Verified 17 evidence references: citation heritage at 21/22/24yr (citation_heritage_21year_latest.json, citation_heritage_22year_latest.json, citation_heritage_24year_latest.json), section cross-lingual at 1K (section_crosslingual_eval_latest.json), linear combinations at 19/22yr + weight sweep (linear_combinations_19year, linear_citation_concat_22year, linear_hybrid05_concat_22year, weight_sweep_22year_latest.json), center projected 22yr evaluation (center_projected_64dim_22year, combined_results.json), legal TF-IDF bge_ corpus (all_experiments_results.json), scale characterization 12k (scale_characterization_results.json), formal suite 165k, v8 holdout OOS, v17b label normalization, v18 coarse hierarchy. All source metrics match reported claims. Negative results (dense jurist gate failure, legal TF-IDF failure, v18 hierarchy failure, OOS ceiling < target) honestly preserved. Data blockers documented with progress.json contradiction explicitly noted.
